_README: Hand-verified expectations asserted against the SHIPPED catalog in CI.
These are not snapshots. Each entry records a fact read off the cited upstream
source by a human, so a failure means one of two things: upstream genuinely
changed, or the generator broke. A snapshot test cannot tell those apart,
which is the whole reason this file exists. Unit tests prove the algorithm;
DO NOT update an entry to make a test pass. Re-read the cited source first.
If upstream changed, update the entry AND the verified_on date in the same
commit, and say so in the message.

supported_ranges.note: 2.7.5 still published exact hosted releases. Later matrices stopped, which is why hosted providers are minor-granularity now.

states.name: Rancher 2.15.1 on its lowest certified Kubernetes is valid
states.why: The 2.15.1 matrix certifies v1.34 as the lowest for both RKE2 and EKS.

states.name: Rancher 2.15.1 one minor below its floor is NOT valid
states.why: v1.33 is below the certified floor of v1.34. Accepting it would be the class of wrong answer this rebuild exists to remove.

states.name: Rancher on EKS managing RKE2 is valid
states.why: Rancher Manager installs on hosted providers. Every sampled matrix lists AKS, EKS and GKE in the Rancher Manager platforms table.

states.name: EKS on Rancher 2.5.12 is valid
states.why: REGRESSION GUARD. max_version was the unparseable v1.20.x, so the loader dropped the whole EKS entry and this returned nothing on the live site for two years.

reachability.name: An old 2.6 cluster can still reach the newest Rancher
reachability.why: The tool's core value is planning a route from where people actually are, which is usually old and out of support.

reachability.name: The previously capped case reaches past 2.9
reachability.why: GetKeyVersions capped every answer at 2.9.2, so nothing beyond the 2.9 line was reachable at all.

reachability.name: A hosted downstream cluster still reaches the newest Rancher
reachability.why: Hosted providers plan at minor granularity, which must not prevent them reaching a destination.
